summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, and CHANGELOG.md. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False), a static render_speed method, and a render override that shows speed when the total is unknown; module-level track() gained a show_speed parameter (default True) passed to the column; Progress.track now infers the total only from an explicit value or a Sized sequence, without raising for unsized iterables. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions and added test_task_progress_column_speed. CHANGELOG has a new Added line. Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or black, per instructions. Those checks remain outstanding.
